title: Relapse
notes:
The running time on Track 16 is incorrectly listed as 0:19, with the actual length being 4:44. "Déjà Vu" is a full track, not a skit.

Track 4 contains interpolations from the composition "Jock Box", written by R. Bush and originally performed by The Skinny Boys.
Track 9 contains an interpolation of "Hot Summer Nights", written by Walter Egan.
Track 17 contains excerpts from "Reaching Out", written by Don Black and Andy Hill and performed by Queen and Paul Rodgers.
Track 18 contains interpolations from the composition "Mais Dans Ma Lumiere", written by Jean Renard.
